reviews.body:
Thanks for picking this up. The remap fixes the cases from #7028 and #6995 (I checked it against fosite v0.49.0). There are a few changes needed before merge, listed below in order of importance. Each inline comment says what to change and which test should prove it.

1. A Redis failure during the jti check must stay a 500 (inline on `client_assertion_errors.go:40`). This is the only change that needs some design. I've sketched it there.
2. The integration test for the expired case must assert the status code (inline on `integration_test.go`, about line 6810).
3. Keep a missing `client_assertion` as 400 invalid_request (inline on `client_assertion_errors.go:41`).
4. Fix the doc comment and add the two comments explaining the matching (inline).
5. Docs: add this paragraph to `docs/arch/17-token-exchange-delegation.md`, after "rejects replay while the assertion is valid. No `client_secret` …" (around line 344):
   ```markdown
   Every failed assertion check (unknown `kid`, bad signature, wrong `iss`, `sub`
   or `aud`, expired or not yet valid, `exp` more than 5 minutes ahead, reused
   `jti`) is refused with HTTP 401 `invalid_client`. The `error_description`
   names the check that failed. A storage failure while checking or recording
   the `jti` is HTTP 500 `server_error`, so clients can retry it. A request
   that sets `client_assertion_type` but omits `client_assertion` is HTTP 400
   `invalid_request`.
   ```
   Also add a before/after line under "Does this introduce a user-facing change?" for the storage-failure and missing-assertion cases.
6. PR housekeeping:
   - Change `Fixes #7028` to `Part of #7028`. The issue's acceptance also includes the strict issuer-only `aud` check, which this PR doesn't do.
   - Drop the `fix(authserver):` prefix from the title and the commit subject. This repo doesn't use conventional commits (CONTRIBUTING.md). Something like "Return invalid_client for failed client assertions" works.
   - Add one line under special notes: "Without a clock-skew margin (#6954), a client whose clock runs slightly fast now gets 401 invalid_client for a future `iat` instead of a 500."

You don't need to do #6954 (clock skew) or the strict audience check here.
Looks good, thanks for the quick turnaround. Please do switch the description to "Closes #7028" before merging.

review_comments.body:
A few lines down, the `wrong_audience`, `wrong_subject` and `expired` subtests (line 6810) only assert `NotEqual(t, http.StatusOK, ...)`. The expired assertion is the actual bug from the issue, and the old 500 passed that check too. All three go through the real provider chain (embedded-key guard plus SPIFFE dispatcher), which the unit test skips, so please replace that line with the same check as here:
```go
					assert.Equal(t, http.StatusUnauthorized, response.StatusCode, body)
					assert.Equal(t, "invalid_client", body["error"])
```

Line 52 maps every invalid_request, so it also catches fosite's "The client_assertion request parameter must be set…". RFC 6749 §5.2 treats a missing parameter as invalid_request, and the SPIFFE path returns 400 invalid_request for the same case (`spiffe_client_auth.go:81-91`). Skipping the remap when there's no assertion keeps both paths the same:
```suggestion
		if err == nil || form.Get("client_assertion_type") != jwtBearerClientAssertionType || form.Get("client_assertion") == "" {
```
Please add a test case: `client_assertion_type` set, `client_assertion` empty, expect 400 invalid_request.
Nit: the Redis twin of this test is a `t.Run` inside `TestRedisStorage_ClientAssertionJWT`. Please move this one into `TestMemoryStorage_ClientAssertionJWT` the same way.

comments.body:
Thanks, all points addressed in the new commit:

1. A Redis failure while reserving the jti stays a 500: `RedisStorage.ClientAssertionJWTValid` calls `server.RecordClientAssertionStoreFailure` in the non-`redis.Nil` branch only, and the strategy wrapper returns `server_error` when something was recorded. I added an exported `NewClientAssertionStoreFailureContext` helper so the Redis test can set up the recorder from the `storage` package. Tests: stub case that records and returns an error (500 `server_error`), `ErrJTIKnown` without a record (401 `invalid_client`), and Redis cases with `mr.Close()` (recorded) and a replay (not recorded).
2. The `wrong_audience`, `wrong_subject` and `expired` integration subtests now assert 401 and `invalid_client`.
3. A missing `client_assertion` skips the remap and stays 400 `invalid_request`, with a test case.
4. Doc comment updated, and the two matching comments added.
5. Paragraph added to `docs/arch/17-token-exchange-delegation.md`.
6. PR body now says `Part of #7028`, with the clock-skew note added; title changed to "Return invalid_client for failed client assertions". The memory test now lives in `TestMemoryStorage_ClientAssertionJWT`.


This comment was drafted with Claude Code.

Thanks, all six review threads are addressed, I resolved them.

On the strict audience question: let's leave it out of this PR. It changes which assertions are accepted, not what we return on failure, and it needs a migration option, so I'll split it out of #7028 into its own issue. That way this PR covers everything left in #7028, so please change "Part of #7028" to "Closes #7028" in the description.
